id: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)

facts.why: The plot summary says the Pevensies reach Aslan's camp but mentions no feast, and no other source opened shows one.

facts.text: Sardines mashed with lemon and parsley on hot buttered toast, as he served Lucy.
facts.why: The tea at Tumnus's cave was not described in any source opened for this call, so 'as he served Lucy' could not be checked.
facts.fix: Sardines mashed with lemon and parsley on hot buttered toast.

vibe.verdict: One of the best of the batch: Tumnus's cave tea room, the lamp-post, Turkish delight and Father Christmas all land.
missing: Lucy meeting Tumnus under the lamp-post
The White Witch's sleigh pulled by polar bears
Father Christmas's gifts (dagger, cordial, horn, sword)
ideas: Swap 'Professor's house scones' for a Beaver dam special.
Swap 'Aslan's camp rosemary roast lamb' note for a line that is not about a feast.
Swap 'Mr Tumnus's tea and toast' note for the lamp-post meeting.
Add a mini Father Christmas gift tag to the cover.
